$comment: Seed data for openconnector register, applied at app install/upgrade via ConfigurationService::importFromApp(). Only mutable config schemas are seeded; log schemas are append-only at runtime and not pre-populated. This file ships with empty arrays — a fresh openconnector install has no Sources, Endpoints, Jobs, etc. Operators populate these via the UI or via Configuration export/import (local ADR-015). Chain B's storage migration is responsible for translating any pre-existing rows in oc_openconnector_* legacy tables into OR objects; that migration is NOT driven by this seed file.
